componentStats.damage: Only genuinely object-legal paid attacks/effects can target components; ordinary actual hit/type defenses apply. No inferred universal elemental immunity. A creature-only spell cannot damage it by label. At0HP remove only that actual component; no HP reset on suppression/reappearance.
componentStats.massRule: Mass is exact union volume of the listed remaining solids times100; clipped openings and destroyed components are not double-counted. This is NEW finite spell-local material behavior, not quarry yield.

supportAndLoad.initialFoundation: Entire foundation on actual immobile ground with source-qualified bearing at least800lb/ft2 and full area support; no bridge, hovering foundation or occupied/unknown underground room is licensed.
supportAndLoad.distribution: Distribute each actual occupant/cargo load over actual supported footprint overlap areas; a tiny concentrated load is not spread over unrelated empty tiles. Resolve overstress as actual source component failure before granting support.
supportAndLoad.supportGraph: Ground tiles require actual foundation under their whole footprint. Upper tiles and roof tiles require an edge-connected same-level surviving tile path to an actual surviving perimeter wall supporting that elevation. Door/window openings do not count as supporting contacts. Stairs require their ground footprint and original connected landing. Losing the last such support removes that component supportive operation immediately; it supplies no free hover or inert infinite cantilever.
supportAndLoad.ownWeight: The fixed initial complete structure is a NEW bounded profile certified only against the declared foundation condition; later altered support/load must be recomputed. No universal engineering certificate is granted.

selectedProcedure.casting: KEEP Action,120feet,V/S/F,rank7/base17RP and exactly86400elapsed seconds from successful formation without concentration. Choose a perceived exact pose of this fixed structure. The whole union/formation volume must fit in actual range/LoE, unoccupied space and declared support; known impossibility rejects before payment. Hidden changed conditions defeat the paid formation atomically, no relocated substitute. No support is invented to legalize an overhang.
selectedProcedure.faction: NEW require one exact canonical named faction, an actual current affiliation record for this caster, and explicit source-qualified permission to invoke this particular faction structure. This is a selected Citadel gate, not an unspoken Faction Army positive-standing aid requirement. Missing affiliation/permission is a whole positive-case hold. A finite NEW Director fixture can state those records conditionally, never claim recovered campaign credentials. Formation grants no standing, sovereign recognition, staff, army, ward, jurisdiction, HQ or membership. Physical doors obey ordinary reach/swept clearance/latch conditions; enemies can use an open door. Later reputation/affiliation changes do not expel occupants or reveal private scores.
selectedProcedure.geometry_and_access: Use only the exact closed-box/CSG profile and stable indexed components. Ground room clear height is10feet between z1 and11; upper room clear height is10feet between z12 and22. Stairs have the declared real slope/treads and open upper stairwell; ordinary movement/Load/squeezing apply. No secret rooms, remote storage, extra tower, trap, lighting, furnaces, beds or detached furnishing stock is created. Windows are genuine holes and can admit weather/attacks; actual full-body fit still governs entry.
selectedProcedure.site_and_work: The actual wall/roof/floor can satisfy only a demonstrated physical shelter/site component. Safety, comfort, ventilation/weather exposure, tools, food, water, fuel, light, beds, skilled workers, rest time, threats, lawful permission and every expedition/crafting/research predicate remain separately sourced. No completed rest, Haven status, research bonus, recipe, wages or abstract Supply is granted by waiting inside.
selectedProcedure.lifecycle: NEW one live Citadel per caster. A successful paid replacement ends that caster old structure without transferring occupants or copying cargo. Nonconcentration caster death/absence or changed affiliation alone does not end it. Original86400second deadline, genuine eligible termination or actual source-specific destruction still controls. There is no new remote voluntary recall permission. Retain each component destruction/HP/pose history and actual occupant/cargo custody; suppression is not repair or new formation.
selectedProcedure.suppression: Actual local magical suppression removes only intersecting structure expression under its exact source contract. Mark the genuine affected component portions unavailable; no completed damage or detached external gear is erased. Loss of a real supporting floor begins ordinary Falling immediately with its original fixed end-of-initiating-slot-next-round Fall Marker; no safe teleport/hover or immediate-impact shortcut is granted. On resumption an occupied component volume does not crush, push or materialize inside a real body/object: retain that conflicted component portion unavailable until legal clear re-expression, under this explicit NEW no-crush local return rule. Other portions and original timers do not reset. A damaged/ended component cannot resume.
selectedProcedure.ending: At deadline/end remove all remaining conjured components, door/stair/roof/fixtures, leaving every actual occupant and independently supplied external object at its actual current identity/position/custody. Apply real support/Falling and item-placement rules, not a free return to ground. No conjured stone, ash, detachable fixtures, permanent harvested building stock or duplicated furnishings survive. External dropped ropes, tools, containers and damaged cargo remain genuinely external and conserved.
